verdict.rationale: Langfuse lets you test changes away from live traffic. Experiments run against fixed datasets instead of production traces (docs-8, docs-61, docs-63), and CI/CD experiments catch regressions before shipping (docs-57). Prompt labels manage deployments across environments (docs-10), and a local Docker Compose instance is recommended for testing (docs-51). However, the evidence never documents a dedicated sandbox or test environment that isolates test data from production data within a single deployment. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/staging environment feature, documented data isolation between test and production projects or environments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
